plan.allocation: Fixed total 2000 USDT per portfolio. BTC raw initial weights are 35% and 40%; ETH receives exact complement 65% and 60%. Component cash budgets are recalculated at the changed weights; no normalization, transfer, rebalancing, or ongoing target weights.

cash_reference.scope: Analytical uninvestedUSDT/no-yield reference;not a new backtest or qualified candidate.

BTC.EMA: alpha=2/(15+1);E[0]=float(first completed daily close),E[j]=(1-alpha)*E[j-1]+alpha*float(C[j]);Python float,adjust=False from datasetday0;never reset across folds.
BTC.entry: At daily decision i,use only completed C[i-1]. Set desired-long only if C[i-1]>max(C[i-16:i-1]) AND Q[i-1]>=1.1*mean(Q[i-41:i-1]) with positive reference mean AND float(C[i-1])>EMA15[i-1]*(1+entry_band). Price/quote reference ranges end i-2,exclude tested close/volume. All three conditions must hold on the same decision;no delayed arming. Quote volume is USDT turnover.
BTC.exit: Set desired-cash if C[i-1]<min(C[i-31:i-1]) OR float(C[i-1])<EMA15[i-1]*(1-exit_band),regardless of volume. Exit takes precedence;otherwise joint entry sets long;all other cases/price or EMA equality preserve desired. Low volume alone never liquidates;volume threshold equality qualifies. Entry and exit bands are independent.
BTC.sizing: At next UTC00:01 real minute open,buy maximum affordable LOT_SIZE quantity and keep residue;exit all valid units on desired cash/terminal. Existing Decimal28 PRICE/LOT/NOTIONAL/5minuteVWAP/participation execution with same1100USDT funds. No leverage,borrow,transfers,rebalancing or cash yield.
BTC.state: Start OOS183 with cash and desired-cash. Historical closes/quote volumes only warm windows;no warmup fills/state replay. Carry cash,units,desired across six folds. Zero reference quote mean disables entry;no division by zero.

ETH.EMA: alpha=2/(span+1);E[0]=float(first completed daily close),E[j]=(1-alpha)*E[j-1]+alpha*float(C[j]);Python float,adjust=False from datasetday0;never reset across folds.
ETH.entry: At decision i,enter only if prior completed C[i-1]>max(C[i-16:i-1]) AND float(C[i-1])>EMA[EMA_span_days][i-1]*(1+entry_band).Channel reference ends i-2,excludes tested close;both gates on same decision,no delayed arming.
ETH.exit: Set desired-cash if C[i-1]<min(C[i-31:i-1]) OR float(C[i-1])<EMA[EMA_span_days][i-1]*(1-exit_band).Exit priority;otherwise joint entry sets long;all other cases/equality preserve desired.Entry/exit bands independent.
ETH.sizing: All affordable independent sleeve cash subject to Decimal28 tick/LOT/filter/participation and next00:01-minute IOC fill assumptions;no leverage,short,stop,scale-in or rebalance.
ETH.state: OOS183 starts with cash and desired-cash;no pending entry or warmup position;daily decisions only using closes through i-1;no fit/labels/OOS tuning.

complete_rules.allocation: Raw BTC initial fractions [.45,.50,.55,.60,.65]; ETH is exact decimal complement [.55,.50,.45,.40,.35]. Total fixed at $2000 per portfolio. Actual starting sleeve USDT [900/1100,1000/1000,1100/900,1200/800,1300/700]. No normalization, maintenance of target weights, transfers, or rebalance. Each changed component is simulated from its own cash budget.

costs.impact_inputs: Previous20 completed UTC day quote ADV and sample stdev20 log daily returns. Buy cash before costs is conservative notional upper bound; sell uses units*reference. Decimal sqrt of budget/ADV, sigma/ADV derived from existing lagged daily function.

plan.direction: Expand BTC initial allocation below the tested 45%-65% interval in the existing volume-confirmed BTC + channel/EMA ETH family.

execution.limitations: Snapshot taken October1, applied uniformly to reused historical data as execution stress assumption, not historical filters. No L2, queue, latency, partial fills or guarantee IOC fills; MARKET_LOT_SIZE does not apply to simulated limit IOC.
execution.percent_price: Check frozen PERCENT_PRICE_BY_SIDE against preceding5 fully closed minute quote-volume/base-volume VWAP proxy. Historical reference-price regime is unavailable; proxy is explicitly an assumption, not historical exchange order validation.
execution.simulation: Hypothetical immediately filled marketable LIMIT IOC at estimated adverse execution price, buy rounded up/sell down to PRICE_FILTER tick; quantity floored to LOT_SIZE. Check static price/quantity bounds and NOTIONAL. Fee paid in USDT; no fee discounts.

plan.hypothesis: If ETH contributes stronger fold consistency than BTC at the tested edge, shifting BTC allocation to 35%-40% may retain positive 1x/2x/3x outcomes with a stable local surface; this is a predeclared sensitivity extension on reused history, not a fresh holdout.

curve_formula.day_offsets: d=0..179; initial vector[0]=capital; post-decision reference NAV at[d*1441+1]; closed minute marks[d*1441+2:(d+1)*1441+1] use close source[(183+d)*1440+1:(184+d)*1440+1]; terminal vector[-1]=terminal_cash+terminal_units*terminal_open. Component Decimal cash/qty converted to float64 for minute multiplication; post/terminal Decimal before float conversion.
curve_formula.timestamps: vector[0]=start pre-trade; [d*1441+1] same decision timestamp post-trade; next1440 entries available_ts of real minute closes strictly after decision through next day00:01. Terminal final duplicate boundary after liquidation. Combination = elementwise sum of exact already-sized component vectors; no reweighting.
